## Backups
SQLite backups run every day at 02:00 UTC.

Private documents are visible only to their owner or explicitly permitted users.
Tenant documents are visible to authenticated users in the same tenant.
Authorization is applied before vector scoring and BM25 candidate selection.

# URL service

## Caching
The URL service uses Redis to cache frequently accessed links.
The cache expiry is 300 seconds.

## Durable storage
PostgreSQL stores the durable URL records.

# Chat service

## Sessions
The chat service uses Redis for session data and rate limiting.

## Storage
The chat service stores messages in PostgreSQL.

# Local deployment

## Server
The API binds to 127.0.0.1 on port 8000.
Ollama serves local models on port 11434.

## Backups
SQLite backups run every day at 02:00 UTC.
Backups are retained for 14 days.
